behavior_trial_columns.start_time: Start time of epoch, in seconds
behavior_trial_columns.stop_time: Stop time of epoch, in seconds
behavior_trial_columns.animal_response: The response of the animal. 0, left choice; 1, right choice; 2, no response
behavior_trial_columns.rewarded_historyL: The reward history of left lick port
behavior_trial_columns.rewarded_historyR: The reward history of right lick port
behavior_trial_columns.reward_outcome_time: The reward outcome time (reward/no reward/no response) Note: This is in fact time when choice is registered.
behavior_trial_columns.bait_left: Whether the current left lickport has a bait or not
behavior_trial_columns.bait_right: Whether the current right lickport has a bait or not
behavior_trial_columns.base_reward_probability_sum: The summation of left and right reward probability
behavior_trial_columns.reward_probabilityL: The reward probability of left lick port
behavior_trial_columns.reward_probabilityR: The reward probability of right lick port
behavior_trial_columns.reward_random_number_left: The random number used to determine the reward of left lick port
behavior_trial_columns.reward_random_number_right: The random number used to determine the reward of right lick port
behavior_trial_columns.block_beta: The beta of exponential distribution to generate the block length
behavior_trial_columns.block_min: The minimum length allowed for each block
behavior_trial_columns.block_max: The maxmum length allowed for each block
behavior_trial_columns.min_reward_each_block: The minimum reward allowed for each block
behavior_trial_columns.delay_beta: The beta of exponential distribution to generate the delay duration(s)
behavior_trial_columns.delay_min: The minimum duration(s) allowed for each delay
behavior_trial_columns.delay_max: The maxmum duration(s) allowed for each delay
behavior_trial_columns.delay_duration: The expected time duration between delay start and go cue start
behavior_trial_columns.ITI_beta: The beta of exponential distribution to generate the ITI duration(s)
behavior_trial_columns.ITI_min: The minimum duration(s) allowed for each ITI
behavior_trial_columns.ITI_max: The maxmum duration(s) allowed for each ITI
behavior_trial_columns.ITI_duration: The expected time duration between trial start and ITI start
behavior_trial_columns.response_duration: The maximum time that the animal must make a choce in order to get a reward
behavior_trial_columns.reward_consumption_duration: The duration for the animal to consume the reward
behavior_trial_columns.reward_delay: The delay between choice and reward delivery
behavior_trial_columns.laser_wavelength: The wavelength of laser or LED
behavior_trial_columns.laser_1_power: The laser power of the laser 1(mw)
behavior_trial_columns.laser_2_power: The laser power of the laser 2(mw)
behavior_trial_columns.laser_condition: The laser on is conditioned on LaserCondition
behavior_trial_columns.laser_condition_probability: The laser on is conditioned on LaserCondition with a probability LaserConditionPro
behavior_trial_columns.laser_start: Laser start is aligned to an event
behavior_trial_columns.laser_start_offset: Laser start is aligned to an event with an offset
behavior_trial_columns.laser_end: Laser end is aligned to an event
behavior_trial_columns.laser_end_offset: Laser end is aligned to an event with an offset
behavior_trial_columns.laser_rampingdown: The ramping down time of the laser
behavior_trial_columns.laser_pulse_duration: The pulse duration for Pulse protocol
behavior_trial_columns.session_wide_control: Control the optogenetics session wide (e.g. only turn on opto in half of the session)
behavior_trial_columns.fraction_of_session: Turn on/off opto in a fraction of the session (related to session_wide_control)
behavior_trial_columns.session_start_with: The session start with opto on or off (related to session_wide_control)
behavior_trial_columns.session_alternation: Turn on/off opto in every other session (related to session_wide_control)
behavior_trial_columns.minimum_opto_interval: Minimum interval between two optogenetics trials (number of trials)
behavior_trial_columns.auto_train_engaged: Whether the auto training is engaged
behavior_trial_columns.auto_train_curriculum_name: The name of the auto training curriculum
behavior_trial_columns.auto_train_curriculum_version: The version of the auto training curriculum
behavior_trial_columns.auto_train_curriculum_schema_version: The schema version of the auto training curriculum
behavior_trial_columns.auto_train_stage: The current stage of auto training
behavior_trial_columns.auto_train_stage_overridden: Whether the auto training stage is overridden
behavior_trial_columns.lickspout_position_x: x position (um) of the lickspout position (left-right)
behavior_trial_columns.lickspout_position_z: z position (um) of the lickspout position (up-down)
behavior_trial_columns.lickspout_position_y1: y position (um) of the left lickspout position (forward-backward)
behavior_trial_columns.lickspout_position_y2: y position (um) of the right lickspout position (forward-backward)
behavior_trial_columns.trial_ind: Trial index (integer row index in session table)
behavior_trial_columns.right_reward_times: Right reward delivery times within trial, relative to goCue_start_time (s)
behavior_trial_columns.left_reward_times: Left reward delivery times within trial, relative to goCue_start_time (s)
behavior_trial_columns.choice_time_trial: Choice time within trial: reward_outcome_time - goCue_start_time (s)
behavior_trial_columns.auto_manual_trial: True if a reward was delivered before the animal made a choice (auto-water or manual reward)
behavior_trial_columns.extra_reward: True if a reward was delivered that is not registered in rewarded_historyL/R

unit_columns.bl_max_p: Maximum increase of p(response_cond_laser) from baseline
unit_columns.euc_max_p: Waveform euclidean distance at maximum p(response_cond_laser)
unit_columns.pass_count: Number of pulses passing in opto tagging
unit_columns.spike_times: Spike times relative to session start (s)
unit_columns.ks_unit_id: Unit id from the Kilosort output
unit_columns.isi_violations_ratio: Rate of the contaminating neuron implied by ISIs < 1.5 ms, relative to the unit's own rate
unit_columns.firing_rate: Mean firing rate over the whole recording (Hz)
unit_columns.presence_ratio: Fraction of 60 s time bins in which the unit fires
unit_columns.amplitude_cutoff: Estimated fraction of spikes missed below the detection threshold, from the amplitude histogram
unit_columns.decoder_label: Unit label from the AIND unit classifier: noise, mua or sua
unit_columns.depth: Unit depth along the probe, same as estimated_y (um)
unit_columns.snr: Template amplitude on the peak channel divided by that channel's noise level
unit_columns.default_qc: Passes the default QC of the AIND sorting pipeline
unit_columns.peak_waveform_raw: Waveform on peak channel of raw waveform
unit_columns.peak_waveform_raw_aligned: Waveform on peak channel of aligned raw waveform
unit_columns.mat_wf_raw_fake_aligned: 2D matrix of aligned fake raw waveform
unit_columns.peak_waveform_raw_fake: Peak waveform of fake raw waveform
unit_columns.peak_waveform_raw_fake_aligned: Peak waveform of aligned fake raw waveform
unit_columns.firing_rate_stability: Coefficient of variation (sd/mean) of firing rate within the stable recording window; smaller is more stable
unit_columns.ephys_cut_start: Start of stable recording window (s); NaN if no cut applied
unit_columns.ephys_cut_end: End of stable recording window (s); NaN if no cut applied
unit_columns.opto_NE_paper: True if the unit passes all quality criteria in basic_ephys_all.json used for the NE paper
unit_columns.antidromic_tier_1: Strict antidromic classification (jitter < 0.01 s, p_antidromic < 0.005, collision passed); OR across PrL and S1 focuses
unit_columns.antidromic_tier_2: Loose antidromic classification (jitter < 0.01 s, p_antidromic < 0.005, no collision required); OR across PrL and S1 focuses
unit_columns.antidromic_latency: Antidromic spike latency from the best focus (s)
unit_columns.antidromic_jitter: Spike latency jitter from the best focus (s)
unit_columns.p_antidromic: P-value of the antidromic response test from the best focus
unit_columns.p_collision: P-value of the collision test from the best focus
unit_columns.electrodes: Electrodes table rows for this unit
unit_columns.unit_name: Unique unit name from the sorting pipeline
unit_columns.repolarization_slope: Slope of the template from the trough to its return to baseline (uV/s)
unit_columns.nn_miss_rate: Fraction of other units' nearest neighbours in PCA space belonging to this unit
unit_columns.isolation_distance: Mahalanobis radius in PCA space enclosing as many other-unit spikes as the unit's own; larger is better isolated
unit_columns.l_ratio: Chi-square probability that other units' spikes belong to this unit's Mahalanobis distribution, per spike; smaller is better
unit_columns.sync_spike_2: Fraction of the unit's spikes falling on the same sample as >= 1 other unit
unit_columns.drift_mad: Median absolute deviation of the unit's median spike depth per 60 s interval, referenced to its overall median (um)
unit_columns.peak_trough_ratio: Template peak value divided by trough value on the peak channel
unit_columns.amplitude_median: Median spike amplitude on the peak channel (uV)
unit_columns.estimated_y: Estimated unit position along the probe depth axis, from monopolar triangulation (um)
unit_columns.original_cluster_id: Cluster id from the sorter before curation
unit_columns.rp_violations: Number of spike pairs closer together than the refractory period
unit_columns.num_spikes: Total number of spikes in the unit's spike train
unit_columns.firing_range: 95th minus 5th percentile of firing rate across 5 min bins (Hz)
unit_columns.decoder_probability: Probability from the AIND unit classifier for decoder_label
unit_columns.sliding_rp_violation: Minimum contamination at 90% confidence, over a sliding range of refractory periods
unit_columns.rp_contamination: Contamination fraction estimated from refractory period violations
unit_columns.isi_violations_count: Number of spikes with an ISI shorter than 1.5 ms
unit_columns.num_positive_peaks: Number of positive peaks in the template on the peak channel
unit_columns.sync_spike_4: Fraction of the unit's spikes falling on the same sample as >= 3 other units
unit_columns.exp_decay: Decay constant of an exponential fit of template amplitude vs distance from the peak channel (1/um)
unit_columns.silhouette: Silhouette score in PCA space from cluster centroids, -1 (poor) to 1 (well separated)
unit_columns.spread: Depth extent over which template amplitude stays above a fraction of its maximum (um)
unit_columns.estimated_x: Estimated unit position across the probe, from monopolar triangulation of the template (um)
unit_columns.num_negative_peaks: Number of negative peaks in the template on the peak channel
unit_columns.sync_spike_8: Fraction of the unit's spikes falling on the same sample as >= 7 other units
unit_columns.recovery_slope: Slope of the template from the post-trough peak over the recovery window (uV/s)
unit_columns.d_prime: LDA separation between this unit's spikes and all others in PCA space, in pooled SDs
unit_columns.velocity_above: Propagation velocity above the peak channel, from trough time vs channel depth (um/s)
unit_columns.velocity_below: Propagation velocity below the peak channel, from trough time vs channel depth (um/s)
unit_columns.half_width: Width of the template trough at half its amplitude (s)
unit_columns.drift_std: Standard deviation of the unit's median spike depth per 60 s interval, referenced to its overall median (um)
unit_columns.amplitude_cv_range: 5th-to-95th percentile range of the per-bin coefficient of variation of spike amplitude
unit_columns.estimated_z: Estimated unit distance from the probe plane, from monopolar triangulation (um)
unit_columns.drift_ptp: Peak-to-peak of the unit's median spike depth per 60 s interval, referenced to its overall median (um)
unit_columns.nn_hit_rate: Fraction of a spike's k nearest neighbours in PCA space belonging to the same unit
unit_columns.peak_to_valley: Time from the template trough to the following peak on the peak channel (s)
unit_columns.amplitude_cv_median: Median across time bins of the within-bin coefficient of variation of spike amplitude
